_doc: Environment texture arrays from Poly Haven (CC0). Each set becomes <set>_albedo.webp (RGB albedo, A height) and <set>_normal.webp (RG normal xy, B roughness, A AO): layers stacked vertically, imported by Godot as Texture2DArray. Layer order = shader layer index. size = px per layer. Real tile size (m) comes from Poly Haven and is written to godot/assets/env/env_textures.json.
